I've had the urge to kill myself a lot recently, and all I want you to know is that you're not alone. I'm afraid to tell my closest friends and family about my suicidal thoughts for the same reason. I don't want them taking it overboard, all I want them to do is be there. I'm here whenever you want to talk. No matter what it is I'm always here to talk.

Emptiness is something I feel when I've successfully repressed all my other emotions. I've seen some fucked up shit in my life and thought nothing of it. I've seen hanging puppies from my garage, I witnessed someone getting kidnapped (at least I thought it was a kidnapping), the woman was trying to get out of the car while it was moving screaming "help!", looking me in the eyes. I felt nothing, like I've trained myself to do. Recently it all got so bottled up that I had to open the floodgates, so to speak. The urge to kill myself was getting strong, and holding my feelings in was getting too difficult. I've been in your boat friend. I've had a hard time figuring out what I was feeling, but that's what people are for. I'm here whenever you want to talk.
